summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing an at-the-market offering agreement with Titan Partners Securities LLC as sales agent for up to $6,500,000 of common stock under an existing Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-291260, effective December 8, 2025). Titan receives a 3.5% commission; Craft Capital Management waived prior placement-agent exclusivity for a 2.0% fee. Sales occur at market prices on Nasdaq under Rule 415, with no obligation to sell. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any stock overhang.
